Hi Ciara / Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can put a tailored proposal together: 

Call recap (short):
- Primary workload: realtime scoring + short-format generation for financial insights (templates + alerts).
- Expected start volume: pilot ~50–100M tokens/month; target steady-state 150–250M tokens/month within 9–12 months if adoption grows.
- Peak/seasonality: expected 2–3x spikes during earnings weeks.

Cost/qualification asks (please confirm):
1) Expected monthly token band for procurement (pick one): 0–50M, 50–150M, 150–300M, 300M+
2) Target unit economics you need for evaluation (desired $/1M tokens) — you mentioned wanting to be in the mid-teens on the call; clarify a target range if possible.
3) Procurement threshold for signature/PO/contract review (example: does anything under $50k run on CC/quick PO or require full procurement & legal?)

What I attached: proposed_pricing_table.xlsx (draft bands + example math) and a one-page SOW stub for a 60-day pilot.

Preliminary bands (high-level, subject to adjustment once you confirm volumes):
- Band A: 0–50M tokens/mo — $40 / 1M tokens (no commit)
- Band B: 50–200M tokens/mo — $14 / 1M tokens (committed reserved capacity discount available)
- Band C: 200M+ tokens/mo — $8 / 1M tokens (enterprise tier / Dedicated options)

Example math: 100M tokens @ $14/1M = $1,400/mo (token-only spend; integration, dedicated capacity, or SRE add-ons are separate).

Next steps:
- Ciara/Alex: confirm the answers to the three asks above and which band looks most realistic for procurement.
- We’ll return a formal quote (line-item pricing + procurement path) and a pilot SOW by EOD Tue if you confirm volumes today.

Thanks — Sean

Thanks Sean — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Monthly band: for the pilot we’re expecting ~60–90M tokens/mo. If the pilot converts we’d plan for a production band of ~140–220M tokens/mo in Q4. Long-term north-star is ~300M/mo but that assumes multiple product lines.

2) Unit economics: when I said "mid-teens" I meant $12–$18 / 1M tokens for evaluation. Finance will be uncomfortable above $20/1M unless we get reserved discounts. For the pilot we could accept an introductory rate if it’s time-limited.

3) Procurement thresholds: our procurement policy is:
   - < $50k annually — can be processed via credit card with a simple vendor form.
   - $50k–$200k — requires a PO and procurement sign-off (no legal redlines typically).
   - > $200k — requires legal review + standard enterprise contract, SLA, and SOC 2 evidence.

We also attached our Q2 consumption export here (finmetrics_consumption_report_Q2.csv) — that will help you model per-user token mix.

If you can map the pricing bands to our pilot band (60–90M) and show the incremental cost to scale to 200–220M, that will help our FP&A and procurement team decide which path to pursue.

—Ciara

Head of Product, Integrations | FinMetrics

Ciara — great, thanks for the detailed note and the Q2 export. Based on your bands I recommend the following practical options and an explicit example so FP&A can see unit economics at scale. I attached an updated proposed_pricing_table.xlsx and one_page_sow.pdf.

Option 1 — Pilot (recommended quick path):
- Commit: 75M tokens/mo for 60 days
- Pilot price: $12 / 1M tokens (introductory, time-limited)
- Estimated pilot spend (60 days): 75M * 2 months = 150M tokens -> $12 * 150 = $1,800 total
- Procurement path: stays below $50k annualized, can do vendor form + CC or quick PO.

Option 2 — Production (reserved discount):
- Commit: 150M tokens/mo (12-month term)
- Price: $10 / 1M tokens (reserved capacity discount)
- Monthly spend: 150 * $10 = $1,500 / month -> annualized $18k (keeps procurement under the $50k prefix, but legal will still want to review standard terms)

Option 3 — Dedicated / Enterprise (for heavy scale):
- 200M+ tokens/mo with Dedicated capacity and SRE add-ons
- Price: $6–$8 / 1M tokens depending on commitments and SLA
- Procurement: likely >$200k annualized; legal + SOC 2 evidence required.

Example comparison table (quick):
- Pilot (75M): ~$900/month equivalent (if we pro-rate to 1 month at $12/1M) — note: quote above computed for the 60-day pilot total
- Production (150M @ $10): $1,500/month
- Enterprise (250M @ $7): $1,750/month

Notes:
- The numbers above exclude potential integration/engineering hours and dedicated SRE pricing if you choose Redwood Dedicated.
- We can cap burst overages at a % during the pilot to avoid surprise charges.

Next steps:
- If you want the pilot, confirm the 75M figure and I’ll send a short SOW + procurement paperwork (DocuSign) by EOD.
- If Finance wants another price ladder (e.g., stepped discounts at 100M and 200M thresholds) we’ll put that in the formal quote.

Thanks — Sean

Attachments: proposed_pricing_table.xlsx (updated) , one_page_sow.pdf
